title: 个人读书清单
requirement:
Build a personal reading-tracker app that lets a reader manage a book shelf, log reading progress, and take notes.

[Shelf Tab]
1. Book list grouped by status (Reading / Finished / Want to read)
2. Each item shows cover placeholder, title, author, and progress percentage
3. Tap a book to open its detail page
4. Preload at least 6 sample books

[Detail Page]
5. Show title, author, total pages, current page, and status
6. Update current page and recompute progress percentage
7. List of reading notes attached to the book

[Add Book]
8. Form to enter title, author, total pages, and initial status
9. Save the new book back to the shelf

[Stats Tab]
10. Show counts per status and total pages read this month
core_functions: 阅读进度更新与百分比计算
constraints: 纯前端应用，数据存储使用localStorage
进度百分比 = 当前页 / 总页数 × 100，四舍五入到整数
预置至少6本示例书籍，覆盖三种状态
notes: This is synthetic example data for demonstration only. Verifies the shelf -> detail -> update-progress -> add-note flow end to end.
